_comment: Per-agent access rules, applied to every code folder foundry/<code>/ in the project. Paths are relative to the code folder; '*' matches one path segment (any feature); '@source' is the code's main-code paths from foundry.json. read_deny: no read, search or write. write_allow: the only writable places (everything else in the project is blocked). create_only: new files only. Bash: commands that name a forbidden path are blocked; 'developer' also may not search recursively or read git history. The main session is not restricted.
